text: dsh-subagent-response-promoter 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Host 侧 Cordis 插件，由 profile bundle 补丁自动注册。它在 Agent 步骤开始时把子 agent 结算响应稳定地排在普通上下文前，并将协调者 relay 从子 agent 的 next-turn 队列移到 next-step 收件箱，使其能在后续安全步骤边界处理。它适合需要及时处理子 agent 回调和 relay 的 DSH 配置；代码未声明 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-subagent-response-promoter is a Host-side Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness, registered by a bundle patch. At safe Agent boundaries, it prioritizes settled subagent responses and moves coordinator relays into a child’s next-step inbox. No API key or external service is declared.
想让父 agent 更快处理子 agent 完成后的回调
能不能让运行中的子 agent 尽早收到协调者发来的 relay
I want child-agent completion messages handled before regular context in the next DSH step.
dsh-subagent-response-promoter 的功能「优先处理子 agent 结算」：在 Agent 步骤进入时，将结算消息稳定排到普通消息之前。
dsh-subagent-response-promoter 的功能「提前投递协调 relay」：将 relay 从子 agent 的 next-turn 队列移至 next-step 收件箱。

dsh-subagent-response-promoter README · dsh-subagent-response-promoter：A small Host-side Cordis plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Continuable background subagents already wake their parent when an activation settles. If a parent is busy, the runtime places the manager-authored `subagent-settled` response in the next safe Agent step. This plugin stably promotes those responses ahead of ordinary context in that step, so the parent handles child callbacks first without polling or interrupting an in-flight model/tool call.

dsh-subagent-response-promoter README · dsh-subagent-response-promoter：The built-in `send_message` tool submits a coordinator relay as the child's next turn. This plugin moves that relay to the child's `next-step` inbox while preserving the original wake, so a running child receives it at its nearest later step boundary instead of waiting for its current turn to finish.

dsh-subagent-response-promoter README · Behavior：Given one proposed Agent step:

```text
ordinary A, child response A, ordinary B, child response B
```

The model receives:

```text
child response A, child response B, ordinary A, ordinary B
```

A coordinator relay inserted into `next-turn` is durably removed and reinserted into `next-step`. The relocation does not cancel an active model request or tool call; it becomes visible only when the Agent reaches a safe step boundary. Other follow-up messages retain their ordinary next-turn behavior.
